selection_rule: Audit all six checkpoints on the same 46-row prompt-disjoint world set. Keep only candidates satisfying every world and retention requirement. Select the largest world gold-sum-logp delta; if candidates are within 0.02, select the earliest dose. Run the itemic structural gate only on that provisional candidate; if it fails, continue in ranked order. If none passes, reject I-22 locally.
interpretation_boundary: The D holdout selects dose and the E retention probes veto drift. Neither is calibrated to predict the online score, and thresholds must not be loosened after results are observed.
